items.text: Devstream #195 - Unannounced 2026 Update!

It’s time, Tenno. Join the Devstream crew on April 24th for Devstream #195 and experience the official world premiere of our Unannounced 2026 Update! What’s the Update name? What month will it arrive? What’s it all about?! You’ll learn it all. Get ready to expect the unexpected…
Watch live from start to finish and earn yourself the following Twitch Drops: an Omni Forma (Built) and one Tauforged Archon Shard (Crimson, Azure, or Amber) per 30 minute claim time!
See you at https://twitch.tv/warframe on Friday, April 24th at 2 PM ET!
** We’re back to having a \ouble Feature live-streaming day!
Warframe Devstream 195: 2pm ET - 3pm ET
Soulframe Devstream 13: 3:30 pm ET - 4:30 pm ET

releases.displayName: The Old Peace: Free Update Available Now

items.text: The ancient battlefields of Tau await in our most ambitious update yet! Available now on all platforms, The Old Peace takes your Warframe journey to a whole new level, bringing you face to face with the Orokin and Sentients through memories of The Old War: a galaxy-spanning conflict that until now has only existed in whispers and echos across Warframe's ever-sprawling lore.

In addition to the latest chapter of our ongoing cinematic Quest, we've made numerous additions to Warframe's cast of characters, innovative game modes, expansions to existing systems, awesome new weaponry and more. And with two new upcoming events arriving shortly after launch, there's plenty to keep you busy over the holidays and beyond.
The Old Peace further lays key groundwork for the future of Warframe in a new Tau-focused update to come later in 2026. Jump in-game today and experience Warframe like never before!

Utilizing Albrecht Entrati's Dark Refractory, you'll discover memories of The Old War both long-buried and rife with forgotten secrets. Enter a fragile period of peace between the Orokin and their Sentient creations during the devastating Old War and unravel the collapse of their failed treaty. Along the way, you'll explore your own role in this dark chapter of the Origin System's history — and what it might mean for the present.
Introducing both new enemies and allies alike, including your Sentient friend named Adis, The Old Peace offers a glimpse at a past you've only imagined. Now you must uncover its grim entirety.

Please Note: The Old Peace Quest requires main story progression up to and including The Lotus Eaters, which is accessible after finishing Whispers in the Walls. To track what you need to complete, check out our official Quest Guide.
To fight as the Heretic of Xata is to have demons at your back. Uriel incinerates foes with searing brimstone, and commands three fiendish summons to do his devil’s work.
Ability 1: Infernalis
Manifest an aura of flames inflicting Heat Damage and Status Effect on nearby enemies. Tap Dodge to take flight as a flaming meteor of destruction.
Ability 2: Remedium
Uriel heals himself and his demons. If his demons are dead, they are resurrected.
Ability 3: Demonium
Uriel rips out the souls of his demons, draining some of their health, and sends them in search of new victims. Souls explode on contact with an enemy, inflicting Damage Vulnerability.
Ability 4: Brimstone
Uriel and his demons create a growing ring of flaming brimstone. Damage inflicted increases with each consecutive hit.
Passive

notes.title: Uriel commands, empowers, and protects three unique demons

items.text: CATENACH: Snares and slows enemies chaining them together. Damage dealt to the last enemy in the chain is inflicted on all snared enemies. (Unlocks with Infernalis)
GULPHAGOR: Latches onto foes dealing damage over time. If killed, a circle of pain is spawned. (Unlocks with Remedium)
VYTHELAS: Inscribes demonic runes upon fallen foes that add Fire Rate and Heat Damage when collected. (Unlocks with Demonium)

A trio of new figures — both divine and damned — have emerged to consecrate our latest update. Following in the footsteps of a familiar luminary on his path toward absolution, they burn brightly with righteous fire.

The Devil's Triad, as they are known, arrive with The Old Peace with useful services and unique stories. Venture back to XX99 to visit them in La Cathédrale via the Sanctum Anatomica, where they serve both as Vendors for new content and potential new romance partners, depending on your predilections (and Quest progression).
Marie Leroux
Sister Marie Leroux, a nun determined to serve Sol by proving that even the most unrepentant devil can be redeemed, brings a human face to the Wisp Warframe.
Lyon Allard
Father Lyon Allard, a priest of Lua tormented by nightmarish visions, brings a human face to the Harrow Warframe.
Roathe
Grand Carnus Roathe, the Heretic of Xata, brings a human — though Orokin — face to the Uriel Warframe.

Operators and Drifters have received significant visual improvements, and you'll have the option to customize yours once again once you download the update and log in. You'll find our reworked face blending much more aesthetically appealing, with updated eye and makeup customization options to boot, including color, transparency and Material Structures. Brows, beards and hairstyles are also overhauled!

Originally revealed to the community as a Reward during Quest to Conquer Cancer 2025, Voruna's highly-anticipated Deluxe Customizations have arrived, ready to be added to your Arsenal via the Voruna Medeina Collection:
Voruna Medeina Skin
Voruna appears as a glorious forest goddess, loyal wolves comprising her graceful armor. The savage huntress is also a protector of the innocent, revered by those unjustly hunted.
Iltis Heavy Blade Skin
Those who feel the vicious bite of Voruna Medeina’s signature heavy axe skin know why its wielder has no need for subtlety.
Manegarmr Ephemera
The wolf-tail plume of Voruna Medina’s signature ephemera displays the refined nature of an inner beast.

Descend through multiple hellish floors of enemies and challenges in order to acquire powerful Rewards! Boasting a new, stacked tileset and 21 floors in total, you'll need to push yourself to the furthest depths (and work closely with The Devil's Triad) in an escalating challenge that rotates each week with new obstacles and forays.

The Perita Rebellion is a game mode that takes you back to the Tau moon of Perita, a flashpoint of The Old War. While you can relive the events of the Perita Rebellion, you cannot stay long — 12 minutes is all the time you have. Work quickly to complete objectives before a final showdown, earning buffs for your Warframe and allies along the way. Completing more objectives will provide you with more Rewards, including Resources you can trade with Marie for the Tektolyst Artifacts required to unlock Tauron Strikes.

With the rediscovery of the Tauron Focus school, a new branch will grow on your chosen Focus School's skill tree. Take advantage of this expansion to unleash your Operator and Drifter's full, devastating power via new Tauron Strikes, earned by collecting Resources in The Perita Rebellion and trading them for Tektolyst Artifacts.

With The Devil's Triad romanceable, new opportunities for connection abound. If you've completed The Hex Quest (and at least one level of The Descendia), you can access conversations with the new Protoframes through the familiar KIM interface from Warframe: 1999 — rebranded here as GIM. Progress your relationships with them simply by talking — no gift-giving or Syndicate Rank requirements here! While you won't be able to enjoy a New Year's kiss with Marie, Lyon or Roathe, you can go on dates with them in special Captura Scenes (and take photos to savor the memories).

Emblazon your Profile and show off your accomplishments thanks to the Honoria system. Earn these new player titles by completing in-game milestones and wear them as badges of honor for your fellow Tenno to behold.
In addition to nine new Arcanes and a suite of Tau Dax Weapon Skins, several all-new Weapons are also available for your destructive pleasure.

Bring hell to the battlefield with Uriel's signature Bayonet: a special new combination weapon type. Occupying both the primary and melee weapon slots, this unique armament blends precision marksmanship with unrelenting close-range combat.
Orokin-era Grineer plated their scythes with gold as a symbol of dedication to their Golden Lords. Gains a percentage of Critical Chance with each Status Type affecting the target.

The sidearm of choice for Prime Grineer warriors, Sagek Prime blends Grineer brutality with Orokin aesthetics. When Sagek Prime inflicts a critical hit, its next shot has a chance to gain significant Status Chance.
Invoke Voruna Medeina, the forest goddess. Her savagery is a blessing to those who hunger for justice.

Recall buried battlefield memories with this collection of ancient mementos. Some things ought never be forgotten. The Klebrik Scaffold, Granmu Prism and Lohrin Brace are Amp components that can be assembled at Quill Onkko in Cetus.
Take up the distinctive arms of the Dax of Tau with this collection of weapon skins.
Adopt the gothic style of the Devil’s Triad with this assortment of hairstyles for the Drifter and Operator.

Be in style whether the year ends in ‘99 or otherwise, with this collection of looks for the Operator and Drifter featuring the signature hairstyles of the 1999 Hex, Roundtable, and Devil’s Triad Protoframes.
You’re only as good as your last haircut - make it a great one with this ultimate collection of looks for the Operator and Drifter featuring all standard hairstyles.
***AVAILABLE DECEMBER 16 - JANUARY 6***

Beginning several days after The Old Peace launch, you'll be able to complete runs of The Perita Rebellion to earn Marks of Valiance exchangeable with Grand Carnus Roathe for new and returning Customizations, including an Honoria, Valdur’s Syandana and the Loiaus Chest Armor! Roathe is relying on your cooperation in exchange for his Orokin good graces, so use the days ahead to get yourself into fighting shape!
***AVAILABLE DECEMBER 18 - JANUARY 15***

Running alongside the first month of the Prime Resurgence End-of-Year Event for a limited time, this new event allows you to exchange Aya with Varzia Dax for Relics that contain components for the six Warframes of the Prime Vanguard: Mesa Prime, Volt Prime, Ember Prime, Ash Prime, Caliban Prime and Protea Prime.

releases.displayName: The Old Peace Update Launches December 10

items.text: The wait is almost over!
Distant and long-hidden memories of Tau will bloom spectacularly on December 10 when our next major update arrives across all platforms – as confirmed during the final Devstream of 2025.

Whisking Tenno on a journey through their own repressed memories of the Old War, The Old Peace brings a bevy of significant new additions to the Warframe canon, including the next chapter of our ongoing Cinematic Quest, new game modes The Descendia and The Perita Rebellion, a highly-anticipated expansion to the Focus School system, as well as the demonic Uriel Warframe, new Protoframes (and ways to romance them), a new Bayonet weapon class, Voruna Deluxe and more.
…all of which will help set the stage for an even larger, Tau-focused update to come later in 2026.
We've been hard at work since first announcing The Old Peace during TennoCon 2025, and can't wait for you to get your hands on the full update next month.
If you missed Devstream 191, you can watch it on our official YouTube channel, or read our comprehensive Overview to catch up on the highlights.
We'll have much more coverage of The Old Peace to share with you in the weeks ahead, so stay tuned.

Hi Tenno,

For those of you who use controllers on the Steam client for Warframe, we are aware of some issues relating to controller inputs. With Echoes of Duviri’s launch, we did post a clarification on how to fix lost controller support for those experiencing it, found here: https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1361266-lost-controller-support-on-pc/#comment-12839111 .

notes.title: For ease of reference, the comment reads

items.text: e just updated the Recommended Official Layouts (we couldn't do this until we'd released the update and there was some difficulty getting them ported over from our Test cluster).

If you're using Steam Input for Warframe (ie: for a PS4 or Steam Controller that doesn't work with the native XInput) restart Steam to refresh the list, edit your Warframe Controller settings in steam, select a layout, and you should see an updated recommended layouts for Playstation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, Steam, and Steam Deck controllers now:

If you are seeing custom controls being reset with our hotfixes, this is due to us publishing fixes for SteamInput, which invalidates custom layouts. We have been actively working on SteamInput (and by extension, SteamDeck) changes but excluded them from our patch notes until we had more news about the status on ongoing issues for our SteamDeck players* -- with that said, we understand that this decision may have led to even more player confusion.
To recap the fixes done to the SteamInput system over the past week:
Echoes of Duviri: Hotfix 33.6.1
Fixed Archwing blink when using Steam Input.
Echoes of Duviri: Hotfix 33.6.3
Fixed Shawzin inputs not functioning properly with Steam Input.

As for further Steam Input fixes, we usually like to get you fixes ASAP however, because of the way Steam Input works, almost every fix we make will invalidate all customized layouts. As a result, we're trying to bundle up as many fixes as possible before sending out another update.

* For our SteamDeck players, we are actively working with Valve to resolve various issues. Once we are closer to a resolution on these, we will post a separate PSA pertaining to that situation. Thank you for your patience on this matter!
Tenno,

We are aware of issues for the Warframe Steam Deck client as a result of the August Steam Deck System Update. Upon installing, the On Screen Keyboard no longer appears to let you enter your login details, preventing players from being able to log-in.

At this time, we recommend you avoid updating your Steam Deck to the August Steam Deck System Update until we find a resolution for this issue. We have contacted Valve and are looking for a solution with them. We’ll update this announcement as more information comes in.
EDIT: A temporary workaround has been discovered with the following steps:
Launch your Steamdeck in desktop mode
Open the Steam app
Switch to Big Picture Mode (monitor symbol top right)
Launch Warframe
UPDATE: August 3 @ 2pm
We have heard back from Valve that they have identified an issue and are looking for a fix.

The crimson maiden of death has been streamlined for more satisfying butchery! Her Abilities have been improved across the board for better maneuvering, additional damage and much more. Check out our patch notes for PC, PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo Switch for full details, as well as a list of general fixes for everyone’s favorite queen of gore.

A Clan’s home is its castle, and now you can customize yours with two new Dojo Rooms: the Grineer Fortress and Orokin Tower, each of which include dozens of matching Decorations. Whether you’re simply looking to spruce up your Dojo, or create an architectural masterpiece, these new additions provide even more options for Tenno designers everywhere.

A selection of lesser-used Warframe Augments have been buffed to better align with their more popular counterparts! As this is part of an ongoing effort to encourage the use of more diverse Augments, you can expect to see additional buffs in the future! Check out our patch notes for PC, PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo Switch for a full list of buffs included in this update.

Get ready for a host of changes and improvements to the Origin System in the first mainline update since last year’s debut of The New War! Update 31.1: Echoes of War introduces replayability to this epic, cinematic Quest, as well as QOL changes, new Customizations, and much more. Be sure to check out our Patch Notes and Devstream 159 Overview for additional details.

For the first time since The New War launched in December, you can now go back and replay Warframe’s biggest cinematic Quest by accessing it from your Codex! This feature allows you to experience your favorite moments all over again and push deeper into any areas left unexplored during your initial run. You’ll also be able to remake decisions and choose alternate interactions, but be advised that these new choices will not impact your game post-New War – the outcomes from your first playthrough will still stand.

The New War features unique playable characters, epic Missions, and a new Sentient-Warframe hybrid named Caliban. Acquire his component Blueprints in-game to wield his overwhelming offensive Abilities and adapt to any battlefield.

Whether you’re deploying to the frontlines for the first time, or reliving your favorite moments, The New War Supporter Packs can give your Arsenal a stylish aesthetic makeover. For a limited time, enjoy up to 30% off evolving Armor, Warframe Skins and other exciting Customizations that feature a menacing new Sentient look! Click here for a full list of what’s included.

Update 31.1 introduces a new Quality of Life change designed to reduce the amount of time spent generating Progenitors (Kuva Larvlings or Sister Candidates) in search of a particular Kuva or Tenet weapon.

When you encounter a Progenitor with unwanted Weapons and opt not to mercy them, their spawned weapon is then added into a ‘reject pile’ until you go ahead and spawn an Adversary. This means that unwanted Weapons will no longer re-appear, ultimately reducing the weapon pool each time you ‘reject’ a Progenitor’s Weapon.
With this change, you’ll spend less time spawning new Progenitors, and more time blasting through foes with the powerful Kuva and Tenet Weapons of your choice!
Save up your Syndicate standing and give your favorite Warframes an edge in battle with powerful new Augments:

Customize your Clan’s home base with two new Dojo Rooms, the Earth Forest Chamber and Uranus Chamber, and enjoy 100 newly-added Grineer Forest and Ocean themed Decorations, including water pumps, turbine blades, and more. Get creative and turn your Dojo into an artistic masterpiece!

Three new Somachord Tones have been added to the post-New War Plains of Eidolon and Orb Vallis, featuring some of the Quest’s most-coveted musical tracks. items.text: Tenno,
Update 30.9.0 is coming on November 11th to All Platforms.
This video walks you through what to expect, and this written post provides an Update breakdown! Get comfy Dreamers!

Without question, The New War is our biggest priority for 2021 and is in full development swing. But just before The New War comes Update 30.9.0! This Update will be a Mainline for all platforms. It is largely Quality of Life and Bug fixes, with a groundwork for a Prime Vault style event that we alluded to in a prior Devstream. This will be the last Update before The New War (Emergency Hotfixes notwithstanding). It also closes off the year with one of many QOL focused Updates this year. Between completely reworking Railjack at the beginning of the year, tying more lore into the Proxima Regions, and finally connecting all things Adversaries (Liches/Sisters) together with Railjack, we’re seeing things really come together with our ‘rework and reconnect’ mindset. We also spent time this year working on ‘The Arsenal Divide’ among many other QOL driven updates.

This year likely felt a little weird - and not just because we’re still working from home for our 19th month straight. We (finally) released a lot of things that were perhaps revealed too early in hindsight. For us, overcoming our backlog of announcements and turning them into releases has been a priority this year, in addition to a larger ratio of reviews and Quality of Life content in the game. This has likely been particularly challenging for veteran players who may appreciate the motivations behind the changes, but are itching for something new or challenging to do (or in the case of content creators, cover). In many cases, veterans are yearning for that ‘something’ to release as ‘The New War’, which we will discuss in the coming weeks. It is indeed the most exciting story quest in Warframe history, and we can’t wait to share it with you.
But first! Update 30.9.0

notes.title: In this update you can expect the following

items.text: The much-requested Forma Quality of Life changes!

This included everything covered in our original Dev Workshop, as well as the addition of opening up Sorties and other Level 30 Warframe restricted content to Mastery Rank 30+ players who have Forma installed!
New Warframe Augments!
Xaku, Lavos, and Trinity receive Augments on November 11! You can read about them in our DevStream recap here!
There’s more - too much to cover in this post, so we’ve written additional Workshops:
Early Player Changes.
Adding a ‘Tenno Guide’ and an effort toward reducing the early-game time and resource demands. Necramech and Railjack acquisition improvements!
Dojo & Decoration Changes
Adding a Spawn item feature, Basic/Advanced Decorating Modes, and much more!
And if you’re looking for ‘What to do in November’ while you wait for The New War:
See here! Alerts and ‘The Story so Far’ abound all month long!
And of course, if you’re wondering how to prepare for The New War?
Ensure your Codex is in the 'To be Continued' state for 'The New War' Codex Quest entry!
Own a Necramech and a Railjack! We’re making it easier to do this soon, and you’ve got time. Spread the word, Tenno! The New War means battle is on - gear up!: See you November 11th, Tenno!
Hi Tenno,

Have you seen the news? Gara Prime Access is releasing on May 25 on all platforms! Our gilded glass hero is nearly here. However - PC Tenno will notice their download size is 2.2 GB. There are a few reasons why.
First, for PC Tenno, it’s a Mainline. If you don’t know what that means, it’s when we deploy all pending changes to the game in a big batch.
Second, it’s jammed with Quality-of-Life. This post is a preview of what you can expect - these are highlights, and only a fraction of the Update notes that await you next week.
As a bonus, this video is for folks who prefer a short overview.
QOL Area 1: Railjack
We have a batch of Quality of Life improvements to Railjack coming, with particular attention to Command and Mission Abort this round!
Command Intrinsic Crew Changes & Fixes: The following changes are a prelude to the release of the Rank 10 Command Intrinsic coming in the Sisters of Parvos Update!
Crew piloting Railjack will now fly to attack the weak-point marker at the end of Railjack Volatile missions.
Added a ‘Contracts’ tab to Ticker's ‘Hire Railjack Crew Members’ in Fortuna.
You can also end Contracts with the Crew Members that are not equipped from here.

This has been highly requested so that you can review your current Crew Hires while perusing potential Hires. This will help you to see what positions you have to fill or who might have to be replaced (get the boot!).
Converted Kuva Liches can now be used as ‘On Call’ Crewmates.
Crew Competencies are now visible in the Tactical Map when hovering over Crew members.
This was highly requested to help make an informed decision when swapping Crew roles in the heat of battle.
Crew Piloting the Railjack will now hold position when you are either in the Archwing Slingshot or using the Forward Artillery.

Improved the ‘Abort’ Railjack mission flow by changing and fixing the following: These changes come after reviewing why Clients in Railjack missions would often find themselves feeling unable to leave after mission completion in public squads. We determined that the language used in these scenarios was unclear/confusing and that there were several other issues related to how rewards were shown in the UI and saved to inventory that we have resolved below!
‘Abort Mission’ will now update to ‘Leave Mission’ in the pause menu after successfully completing a Railjack mission.

It will also prompt a new message that better describes what will occur: “Leave Mission: You will keep mission rewards and XP earned to this point, but will disconnect from your squad. Are you sure you want to leave this mission?” vs. the previous “Abort Mission: You will keep progress but forfeit the completion rewards and bonuses. Are you sure you want to abort this mission?”
Fixed Clients not being able to ‘Abort’ Mission and retain their rewards once the mission objective has been completed.
Fixed the End of Mission screen not showing the full collection of rewards earned in the mission when returning to the Orbiter.
Fixed ‘Aborting’ Railjack Mission not awarding items earned from POIs.
QOL Area 2: UI
We are doing update passes on some of the social aspects of Warframe, with particular attention paid to screen reworks for Friends and Clans this time around!
Multiple screens have been refreshed with a new look and certain new functionalities! All of the screens listed below also now all take on your chosen UI theme.
‘Junction Tasks’ Screen Changes:
Rewards will now automatically scroll across the screen to give you a full preview of what will be earned on successful Junction completion.
Each task now has a descriptive blurb to help direct you on how to get started on the task.
‘Clan’ Screen Changes:

Everything is now more neatly displayed on a single screen. Previously tucked away features such as ‘Edit Hierarchies’, ‘View Alliance’, ‘Invite Member’, and ‘Message of the Day’ are now immediately visible and accessible.

In addition to your MOTD, you can now also have a much longer Clan and Alliance message displayed below! All display on the right hand side of the Clan screen in the ‘News’ Tab. The option to edit the MOTD and message below is available in this window for those with permissions to do so.
Added more Clan information to the screen:
Added the total number of Clan members to the screen.
Added the ‘Founding Warlord’ to the screen.
The Alliance Screen has also been reskinned:
Added the total number of Members to the screen (in addition to the previously live ‘Allies’ count).
‘Friends’ Screen Changes:

Everything is now more neatly displayed in a single screen. Previously tucked away features such as ‘Recent Players’, ‘Available Sessions’, and ‘Batch Remove’ are now immediately visible and accessible.
Added ‘Recruit Tenno’ option - This will take you directly to the ‘Refer a Friend’ page on the Warframe website to recruit your pals and earn rewards for doing so.
QOL Area 3: New Player Experience

We are chipping away at the friction in our New Player Experience, as many of us have started new accounts ourselves to cross-reference with player feedback we receive! We have a batch of improvements coming next week.

The Limbo Theorem and Hidden Messages Quests no longer require you to finish crafting the Warframe components to move onto the next stage of the Quest. Simply earning the Blueprint is now enough to progress.
Junctions now award Credits upon completion!
A script will be run to give Credits to players who have already completed the following Junctions:
Earth to Venus: 5,000
Venus to Mercury: 10,000
Earth to Mars: 15,000
Mars to Ceres: 20,000
Mars to Phobos: 20,000
Ceres to Jupiter: 30,000
Jupiter to Europa: 40,000
Jupiter to Saturn: 40,000
Saturn to Uranus: 60,000
Uranus to Neptune: 80,000
Neptune to Pluto: 80,000
Pluto to Eris: 100,000
Pluto to Sedna: 100,000
And because we need to remind everyone…
“To be Continued…”
The New War in the Codex will make more sense in the interim. We have a story to tell, Tenno.

Corpus Proxies are rising up across the Origin System. Crewmen are being replaced with Ospreys, MOAs and other machines of the merchant cult. Tenno, we need you to get in there and quell this rebellion.
We’ve located four major regions of increased Proxy activity:
• Mars (Defense): 50,000 Credits + Exilus Adapter
• Neptune (Interception): 50,000 Credits + Pistol Riven
• Jupiter (Survival): 50,000 Credits + Orokin Catalyst and Reactor Blueprints
• Europa (Defense): Rakta Syandana + Stratos Emblem
From July 19, 2 p.m. ET until July 22, 2 p.m. ET on all platforms, complete these four Alerts and bring these machines to heel.
It’s been six months since Arbitrations began in Warframe and thanks to your feedback, we’ve introduced updates that change how you play and new rewards for you to earn!
If you’re unfamiliar with Arbitrations -- end game mission variants that unlock once you’ve completed the Star Chart -- you can read more about them here!

Starting today on PC, you’ll be able to revive squadmates in Arbitration Missions but you must first earn the chance! When your squadmate falls in battle, a revive tower will be dropped. While the revive tower is on the map, you must take down Arbitration Drones to receive an item called “Resurgence Burden."

Bring five Resurgence Burdens to a tower to revive a teammate! However, it’s all or nothing, Tenno. You won’t be able to bank Resurgence Burdens so you and your squadmates must deposit all five Resurgence Burdens simultaneously!

Our goal with this update is to maintain the endgame challenge that Arbitrations promised, while also ensuring that if you or a teammate is knocked out, they still have a chance to jump back into the fight.
We’ve also changed enemy scaling in Arbitrations to be the same as regular Warframe missions. Enemies will quickly become more difficult, so stay on your toes and be careful, Tenno!
You can now spend Vitus Essence in the Arbitrations Market to purchase Archgun Rivens, as well as new cosmetics! The new cosmetic offerings include:
AMPREX TELOS SKIN
ATOMOS TELOS SKIN
ATTERAX TELOS SKIN
ILLUMINA JUDICIUM
In Arbitrations, where death’s shadow looms, life’s fire burns brightest. This light sculpture is a tribute to that survival.
JUDICIAL OCULUS
Eyewear created by the Arbiters for those they deem worthy.
As a new rotation reward, you now have the chance to earn the elusive Aura Forma Blueprint! Craft Aura Forma to further customize your Warframe and fine-tune your Mod builds.
Take on the new and improved Arbitrations if you have what it takes, Tenno!
For more information or to give feedback on the changes, make sure you head over to our Official Dev Workshop!!

releases.displayName: The Chimera Update is live! Can you survive the Arbitrations?

items.text: Gear up with two new Weapons for new high-level Alerts!
The Chimera Update brings the new Arbitrations: Lethal Alert system, the new Daily Tribute 2.0, new Precepts and more.
The Arbiters of Hexis have a new challenge for you, Tenno. Complete their Arbitrations, and they’ll reward you in kind.

After completing the Star Chart, you’ll unlock a new Mission Type called Arbitrations. Survive against Level 60+ enemies to earn new rewards and bigger payouts than normal Alerts. These Alerts rotate between endless Missions around the Star Chart every hour. But there’s a catch -- you only get one life. No Revives. You die, and that’s it. These Alerts also add a few other wrinkles to the gameplay, but we’ll let you discover those on your own.
In addition to bigger reward payouts, completing these Alerts will also give you Vitus Essence, a Resource used to build new cosmetic items. Seek out the Arbiters in the Relay to learn more.
We’ve updated our Daily Login System to give you more choice and more appropriate reward scaling as you delve deeper into the game.
Milestones

On major Milestone days (every 50 days between 0-1000), you’re now given up to three choices! For example, when you reach a Primed Mod Milestone, you’re given a choice between three different Primed Mods rather than the static, singular choice in the old system.
Sigils and Resources: Days 50, 150, 250, etc.
Primed Mods: Days 200, 400, 600, etc.

Weapons: Days 100, 300, 500, etc.: The next time you reach a given Milestone category, you'll see a new item appear in place of what you've already chosen (if applicable).: Daily Tribute Reward Scaling: Rewards on non-Milestone Days now scale based on the amount of days you’ve logged on. For example, on Day 1, you could get one Tellurium, but on Day 1000, you could get six Tellurium! This applies to Credits, Endo, Booster Durations, Resources, Syndicate Medallions, Relics and Forma Blueprints.: Evergreen: Starting at Day 1050, you’ll receive Evergreen Milestones with three rewards to choose from. These are rotated every 50 Days though the following options:
3 x Forma
3 x Exilus Adapter
4 x Weapon Slots
50,000 Kuva
30,000 Endo
7-Day Boosters (Affinity, Credits, Resource)
3 x Rifle Riven
3 x Melee Riven
3 x Secondary Riven

Tenno, we’re floored by your incredible Dojo works of art. To aid in your conquest of the Dojo artform, we’ve created a massive Sandbox Room for you to dream big! Think of this room as a blank canvas to work with. You could create a bustling Arcade, build an Ayatan dragon, craft a shrine to Rhino Prime — whatever you want to make, you can make it here! We’ve also added 41 new effects (like falling leaves, flies and sparks) and seven new structural decorations to help bring your artistic vision to life.

Speaking of artistic vision, we’re hosting a Dojo Decoration Contest! You could win an exclusive Trophy for your Clan, and even better, your Dojo could be featured on the Star Chart for everyone to visit! Visit the official contest thread for more details.

items.text: Cephalon Simaris needs skilled hunters for a ruthless experiment. Enter the portal to test the limits of your power against the battle-hardened beasts of the Sanctuary. Work together to survive the odds and recover the remains of a shattered Warframe.
//Message From: Cephalon Simaris
//Subject: An experiment
Hunter, you have proven your dedication to the cause. It is time to enlighten you, to show you what we have built together. It is time to enter the Sanctuary.

In the simulated universe of the Sanctuary, my data-immortals have fought each other countless times. Through this violence, I have studied and documented their character. But my study cannot be complete without the power of the Tenno. Your duty in this experiment is to kill as many specimens as possible. In this chaos, the true nature of these creatures will be revealed... as will yours.
WHERE TO GO
⠂Talk to Cephalon Simaris at the Sanctuary in the Relay
WHAT TO DO
⠂Enter the portal to the Sanctuary and survive against increasingly difficult waves of enemies.
⠂When a wave is complete, Simaris will open a portal to a new zone within the Sanctuary. At the start of a new wave, quickly kill as many enemies as possible to gain Focus.
⠂Travel deeper within the Sanctuary to recover the missing Khora Blueprints, new Captura Scene and more.
⠂It would be wise to bring your strongest Tenno allies along with you.
FEEDBACK: LOVE IT OR LOSE IT

This is one of the first completely new Game Modes we have added in a while and we've tried to include some player feedback in its offerings! If you have thoughts on what you've played, please provide some constructive feedback here.

releases.displayName: Shrine of the Eidolon Update: Out now!

items.text: It began with the Old War.
“The Sentient was a deformed creature, sent from some dark fold of distant space, crushing towers and citadels across Earth...”
Until meeting its fate in a climactic battle.
“The device detonated. The Sentient's body shuddered, wracked by a cacophonous energy. Fragments of the Sentient crashed to the Plains and marshes and flatlands...”
These fragments are known as the Eidolons -- mysterious titans that continue to wander the Plains and loom over the people of Cetus.

Most of you have seen the Teralyst, a beast that rises from the watery depths every night. Legends speak of two more Eidolons that fell to the Plains, dormant for centuries but ever present in the hearts and minds of the Ostrons.
Eidolon Hunters eager to prove their worth are trying to summon these creatures again. Are you worthy, Tenno?
GANTULYST
Legends say the Gantulyst wields an enormous boulder for an arm and radiates powerful beams of Sentient energy. The Ostrons built a shrine in its honor hoping to gain its favor.
HYDROLYST
The Ostrons believe the Hydrolyst is an omen of impending natural disaster. Stories describe a distinct, pungent aroma that precedes the arrival of this toxic beast.
RIVEN TRANSMUTATION

If you’re worthy, you’ll receive Riven Transmuters from the new Eidolons. These consumable items can transmute four Riven Mods into a brand-new Riven. Combining four Rivens of the same type (i.e Rifle, Melee, Shotgun, etc.) will result in a transmuted Riven of that type.
DRIVE THE DARGYN
Take your fight to the skies by hijacking any Dargyn in the Plains. Use these to aid in your search for the new Eidolons.
WARFRAME POWER & WEAPON CHANGES
In case you missed it - we’re doing some Warframe and Weapon rebalancing! Check out our Dev Workshop to get a deep dive into what we've changed and why.
